title: astoma galiocarpum
intro: Astoma galiocarpum, commonly known as  A. galiocarpum, is a plant species that belongs to the family Gentianaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Astoma galiocarpum include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit cardioprotective effects, and show promise in treating respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of A. galiocarpum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
